title: Encrypt and Decrypt Strings, R Objects and Files
text: consistent interface encrypt/decrypt strings, objects, files connections R. symmetric asymmetric encryption methods supported. Based libsodium crypto library.

title: Encrypt and Decrypt Strings, R Objects and Files
text: four functions inverses. encryt_string (decrypt_string) encryt_object (decrypt_object) encryt_file (decrypt_file) save_object (retrieve_object) following table summarizes functionality:

title: Encrypt and Decrypt Strings, R Objects and Files
code: library("safer")

title: Encrypt and Decrypt Strings, R Objects and Files
text: Henceforth, shall default password symmetric case: pass.
code: # symmetric case: temp <- encrypt_string("hello, how are you", key = "secret") all(   is.character(temp)   , decrypt_string(temp, "secret") == "hello, how are you"   , class(try(decrypt_string(temp, "nopass"), silent = TRUE)) == "try-error"   )  ## [1] TRUE  res <- encrypt_string("tatvamasi", ascii = FALSE) isTRUE(identical(decrypt_string(res), "tatvamasi"))  ## [1] TRUE  # asymmetric case: alice <- keypair() bob   <- keypair() temp  <- encrypt_string("hello asymmetric", alice$private_key, bob$public_key) temp2 <- decrypt_string(temp, bob$private_key, alice$public_key) identical("hello asymmetric", temp2)  ## [1] TRUE

title: Encrypt and Decrypt Strings, R Objects and Files
code: # symmetric case: temp <- encrypt_object(1:3) all(   is.raw(temp)   , decrypt_object(temp) == 1:3)  ## [1] TRUE  temp <- encrypt_object(iris, ascii = TRUE) all(   is.character(temp)   , decrypt_object(temp) == iris   , identical(decrypt_object(temp), iris))  ## [1] TRUE  rm(temp)  # asymmetric case: alice <- keypair() bob   <- keypair() temp  <- encrypt_object(1:10, alice$private_key, bob$public_key) temp2 <- decrypt_object(temp, bob$private_key, alice$public_key) identical(1:10, temp2)  ## [1] TRUE

code: # Generate a keypair and save to disk using openssl key = openssl::ed25519_keygen() tmp = tempfile() openssl::write_pem(key, tmp)  # Read it back using read_keypair keys = read_keypair(tmp) str(keys) #> List of 3 #>  $ public_key : raw [1:32] d8 64 3f 1f ... #>  $ private_key: raw [1:32] 1c ce 59 41 ... #>  $ seed       : NULL  # Validate that keys are same identical(keys$private_key, key$data) #> [1] TRUE identical(keys$public_key, key$pubkey$data) #> [1] TRUE

title: safer — safer-package
text: consistent interface encrypt/decrypt strings, R objects,   files. Alternatives base R functions 'serialize/unserialize',   'save/load' provided. following functions provided: encrypt_string/decrypt_string: encrypt_string encrypts   string string decrypt_string decrypts encrypted   string(encrypted using encrypt_string) encrypt_object/decrypt object: encrypt_object encrypts R   object raw object string decrypt_object decrypts raw   object string(encrypted encrypt_object) encrypt_file/decrypt_file: encrypt_file encrypts file   another binary ascii file. decrypt_file) decrypts file   (encrypted encrypt_file) save_object/retrieve_object: save_object encrypts R   object raw text connection file. retrieve_object decrypts   raw text connection file (encrypted save_object.)
